title: Fully Automatic Coronary Calcium Score Software Empowered by Artificial Intelligence Technology: Validation Study Using Three CT Cohorts.
summary: Across 2,985 patients in three previously published CT cohorts, the system had 93.3% per-lesion sensitivity and 0.11 false-positive lesions per patient; Agatston-score ICC was 0.99 overall and weighted kappa for risk categories was 0.94. Direct comparison against manual reference scores in three retrospective cohorts and four CT models. It is single-center; only 116 participants had Agatston scores above 400, which the authors identify as insufficient for strong validation in that subgroup.
ai_technology: An atlas-based deep-learning system automatically detects coronary calcium and estimates Agatston scores from CT, compared with manually segmented scores.
organization: Biomedical Engineering Research Center, Asan Institute for Life Sciences, Asan Medical Center, University of Ulsan College of Medicine, Seoul, Korea
